I have this thing I do when I read certain manga. I find a song I think is appropriate and put it on repeat while I read for hours.

I guess this causes some hardcore associations in my subconscious, because the end result is that hearing that song reminds me both of the manga I was reading, as well as my emotions during that time. What surprised me the most is how consistent it is, the same thing happens each time I do it.

Some examples are:

Berserk: Strobe - deadmau5

Medaka Box: Bambous - Caravan Palace

Anyone else do something similar? Or maybe you have your own bizarre rituals?
[DISCUSSION] Does anyone else pair music to their manga?

For me it's the reverse - the songs I listen to while reading get associated with the plot/action/emotions that managed to resonate to it. It's something that happens inadvertently for me, and I like it that way.
